content: Before interpreting pixel differences as a control regression, measure unmodified renderer repeatability; compare synchronized physical state, camera calibration and success separately. Preserve failed gates and declare any measurement amendment before new holdout tests.
applicability: Repeated MuJoCo RGB collection and rendering comparisons
embodiment: Simulation observations only; no RGB-D or measured six-axis force required
count_unit: native repeatability checks (full encoded episodes and 32-frame raw prefixes)
known_limits: Do not use this rule to ignore camera, state or success mismatches
